system.longDesc:
These drugs render the subject unconscious when they take effect and cause them to sleep for eight hours. A character who tries to resist the effect can make a TN 11 Constitution (Tolerance) test to remain awake and active for one minute before they must make another test. A sleeping character under the effect of a sedative can be awoken, but they are groggy and effectively fatigued until the drug wears off without the use of a stimulant to help them overcome the sedative’s effect.

Resources TN 9.
